deadline.value: December 2, 2026 deadline for PhD in Mathematics and Specialization in Statistics
deadline.quote: Ph.D. in Mathematics Opens: September 2, 2026 Closes: December 2, 2026

gre_general.value: The GRE General Test is not required.
gre_general.quote: For Fall 2027 admissions, the GRE General Test and GRE Mathematics Subject Test are not required. However, the GRE Mathematics Subject Test is highly recommended, as it provides our Admissions Committee with additional context to assess applicants’ preparedness for the rigorous academic standards of our program.

gre_subject.value: The GRE Mathematics Subject Test is highly recommended.
gre_subject.quote: For Fall 2027 admissions, the GRE General Test and GRE Mathematics Subject Test are not required. However, the GRE Mathematics Subject Test is highly recommended, as it provides our Admissions Committee with additional context to assess applicants’ preparedness for the rigorous academic standards of our program.

supervisor.value: Pre-application supervisor requirement is not stated.

funding.value: First-year PhD financial support package includes minimum $37,500 commitment plus tuition, mandatory fees, and non-resident supplemental tuition.
funding.quote: At UC San Diego, the general financial support package for first-year Ph.D. students includes a minimum commitment of $37,500 plus tuition and mandatory fees. If you are not a California resident, the non-resident supplemental tuition will also be covered.

entry_route.value: Successful applicants must hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent with at least 3.0 GPA.
entry_route.quote: Successful applicants must hold a bachelor's degree or the equivalent from an accredited institution in the United States or from a recognized university-level academic institution abroad and at least a B average (3.0 GPA) or its equivalent by the time they enroll.
